ridgecv_ff_blocked.note: RidgeCV's float-float fallback (the only route when the float32 Gram cannot be factored): every float-float statistic becomes FOLD_BLOCK-row block partials (one thread per (statistic, block), the rw_gram_parts_kernel shape) folded blocks ascending, and the float-float Cholesky of each untrusted alpha runs on one block team (t_cholesky split, every entry its own chain) in one launch per fold instead of grid 1 / block 1 per alpha. The Ridge refit (_ridge_ff_grid) takes the same blocked statistics and team solve. Host column (ridgecv.mojo _kf_ff_stats_host, ridge.mojo _ridge_ff_host) folds the same blocks. Bits change (block fold order); NV and AMD must match per arm. Cost reasoning: same work, n/FOLD_BLOCK times the threads in flight; no shape rule. NOT COMPILED (lanes never compile), NOT MEASURED.

enetcv_score_blocks.note: Arm value = rows of the fold's span per score block (fixed count, not a data shape; legal set enforced in core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo). The held-out squared errors of every path point are (path, alpha, row-block) partials folded blocks ascending (fold_parts); host column (cd.mojo esb_host_score) folds the same blocks. Default 4096 in IDENTICAL; arm 1024 the smaller block; arm off (`MOJOLEARN_CLASSICAL_ENETCV_SCORE_BLOCKS_OFF`) is the old one-block-per-path ecv_score_staged_kernel. Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm): NV/AMD ms off -> 4096 enet-cv istella 1052.9->555.2 / 3567.8->818.1, taxi 122.4->101.6 / 483.8->359.2; lasso-cv istella 1041.8->555.9 / 3530.4->848.7, taxi 122.6->97.9 / 513.2->364.5; r2/rmse identical. PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-act-2 2026-10-08; numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md.
